name: Shiiku Chuu ~Zenryousei Mesu Dorei no Manabiya~
original_name: 飼育中 ～全寮制メス奴隷の学舎～
source:
Monastery is transformed into an academy where orphans and abused children are gathered. New owner decides to use it to satisfy his dark desires and desires of powerful people sending unspeakable requests.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/02/vn-of-month-february-2001-tasogare.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
修道院被改造成一所學院，聚集了孤兒和受虐待的兒童。新主人決定用它來滿足他的黑暗慾望和權貴們難以啟齒的要求。
